name: Demio
description: Demio is a browser-based webinar platform for live, automated, and on-demand events with registration, engagement, recordings, analytics, and marketing integrations.
agentUseSummary: Connect owner-generated Demio account credentials through Railway's encrypted store, then retrieve only an aggregate count from the fixed event inventory endpoint.

capabilities.label: Count event inventory
capabilities.description: Inspect only aggregate counts from the fixed Demio event inventory endpoint.

approvalRequired.label: Count event inventory
approvalRequired.description: Read the fixed Demio event list and return only aggregate inventory counts.

blocked.label: Event identity and content
blocked.description: Event and session IDs, names, descriptions, dates, registration and room links, presenters, custom fields, branding, and raw records are not returned.

blocked.label: People and engagement
blocked.description: Registrants, attendees, contact details, join links, attendance, chat, polls, handouts, questions, responses, and analytics are not exposed.

blocked.label: Media and communications
blocked.description: Recordings, replay links, transcripts, slides, videos, emails, reminders, integrations, webhooks, and communications are not exposed.

blocked.label: Changes and raw API
blocked.description: Registration, event and session changes, automation, integrations, and every other mutation plus arbitrary paths, IDs, filters, pages, origins, bodies, headers, credentials, and raw responses are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Every account-wide aggregate event inventory read requires matching Relay approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Selected aggregate reads run without Relay per-action approval while account binding, the fixed origin and endpoint, response cap, content exclusion, audits, encrypted credentials, and Demio quotas remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one approval-aware Demio aggregate event inventory tool using encrypted account credentials.
Railway mounts one approval-aware Demio aggregate event inventory tool using encrypted account credentials.

providerSetup.blocker: A Demio account owner must generate a dedicated API key and secret, provide them through the approved secure setup path, confirm account API eligibility and quota, and complete Railway staging acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Generate dedicated owner credentials, store them only through Railway's encrypted connector setup, exercise Safe denial/approval and Dangerous aggregate reads, verify credential rotation and local disconnect, deploy through the integration lane, and run live acceptance without exposing event records.

evidence.supports: Demio documents its public API, 180-request-per-minute limit, daily quotas, account API usage tracking, suspension policy, and official Apiary reference.
Demio's official linked Apiary project is the public versioned API reference used for the fixed event-list contract.
Demio documents separate event/session and participant retrieval surfaces and date_id session identifiers; Relay excludes these identity and people endpoints.
